text: A first invocation that returns [PASS] because candidates.json is missing is normal; the scripts prepare files asynchronously and the agent should be re-triggered once the batch is ready.
When the security reviewer returns verdict 'approve', the security analyzer's cycle is complete and subsequent invocations should return [PASS] — no re-analysis or re-push is needed.

When a user requests 'clean and refresh agent_workspace', the security analyzer should perform a hard sync (git fetch origin && git reset --hard origin/agent_workspace) on the next run before checking for a new candidates.json batch — this clears any stale state from a completed cycle.
